_note: Evaluation system profiles. A profile = one cluster (clusters.json) + a subset of memories (memories_default.json). Values are NOT redefined here; they come from the two config files, so provenance tags (SPEC/PUBLIC/ASSUMED) live there. Human-readable spec: doc-mk/Evaluation/system-specs.md

SYS-1.name: B200x8 + host DRAM (As-Is class)
SYS-1.purpose: Today's vLLM-class hierarchy (HBM + CPU DRAM). Lower bound for heterogeneity benefit.

SYS-2.name: B200x8 + DRAM + CXL-PNM
SYS-2.purpose: Adds a capacity tier with near-memory attention (host-staged).

SYS-3.name: B200x8 + DRAM + HBF
SYS-3.purpose: Adds a GPU-reachable high-BW / high-latency / write-limited tier.

SYS-5.name: Vera Rubin x8 + all six memories
SYS-5.purpose: Next-gen GPU (HBM4, 384 GB, 28 TB/s) with the same memory set; cHBM scales with the paired GPU.
